description: The characters the name rules list (security design S23). The server's patterns (server/src/drive/name-patterns.generated.ts) and the database's checks (db-migrate/generated/items-name-checks.sql, repeated in db-migrate/migrations/0002_items.sql) are both generated from this file by scripts/src/name-characters.ts; a repository check fails when either is out of date. Ranges are inclusive code points in hexadecimal.
source: The Unicode Character Database, version 18.0, as carried by Node.js 24's ICU (process.versions.unicode): every code point with the property White_Space, and every code point of General_Category Cf (Format).
